Your corner read 2: delete F, keep L, A, W, insert N.
Counting spot by spot gave 4 because it never lets
letters slide; one delete shifts LAW into line.
Each of the 16 cells you filled took the cheapest of
three neighbours you had already filled. A small grid
replaces trying every sequence of edits.
Spell checkers and DNA alignment fill this grid.
